'''Aralah Ren''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Ren managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] construction to others.
